style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EMr. ABC, 24 year old work IT Professional hailing from Odisha walks into the Med Gastro OPD with dyspeptic symptoms and says he has been having heartburn, vomiting and regurgitation since 1-2 months. He initially had heartburn and regurgitation in the last 3 months followed by mutiple episodes of non bilious non projectile vomiting, more after taking meals, not a\/w coffee ground vomitus. He says he is on a strict diet and exercise training as a part of weight loss programme and has been taking home made\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EMenthi water for the same.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe doesn't give history of fever, loss of appetite, altered bowel habits, postprandial fullness, yellowish discolouration of eyes and skin, black colored stools, headache, neck rigidity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe has no comorbidities. He consumes alcohol once in a while and doesn't smoke.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHis parents and siblings are absolutely fine and he doesn't give any significant family history as such.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is a non vegetarian. His bowel and bladder habits are regular. His appetite is good and has good sleep.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFirst visit in MGE and we decide to do an Oesophagogastroduodenoscopy on the same day.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe expected an ulcer to be seen but we see not one or two but Extensive gastric ulcerations as shown below.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; Patient came back with c\/o vomiting after taking tablets for 2 days. We had to stop the Hp kit and resume him on PPIs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWe took a decision of repeating endoscopy again and this time take good biopsies from all over the stomach as per protocol.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWe did a repeat endoscopy and the HPE report is awaited.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr PRESENTATION OF CHRONIC DIARRHOEA"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Mr XYZ , a 20 year old lean Hindu boy, native of kerala, staying at chennai for his studies has been for a 1 week joyous trip with his friends somewhere in the mid february only to visit us in 1st week of March with complaints of 3-4 episodes of small volume , semisolid , bloody mucus stools. He also gives history of dyspeptic symptoms intermittently when he has oily or spicy food. He has loss of appetite, flatulence and feels tired easily these days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe completed a 5 day course of antibiotics which are supposedly Ciprofloxacin and ornidazole. He was on probiotics for 10 days before he came to us. He says he finds no improvement in his symptoms after all the above treatment.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe says he doesn't have any abdominal pain, vomiting, nausea, black colored stools, pain while defecation, weight loss, fever, nocturnal symptoms, yellowish discolouration of skin or eyes, clay colored stools, evening rise of temperature, cough.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPAST HISTORY: \u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003ENo known comorbidities.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history tuberculosis in the family.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo significant history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMixed diet\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite reduced\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBladder regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe doesn't consume alcohol or smoke.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180; font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EConscious oriented, Thin built\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, icterus, cyanosis. clubbing or lymphadenopathy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPulse\u003Cspan style=\"color: red;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E- 88 bpm, regular on right radial artery, Normal volume\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003EBP - 120\/70mmhg in supine posture on both arms\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003ERR- 16cpm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003ESp02- 98% on room air\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPER ABDOMEN -\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EInspection\u003C\/span\u003E: Scaphoid, No scars or sinuses\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EPalpation: \u003C\/span\u003ESoft, Non tender, Liver and spleen not palpable\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EPercussion:\u003C\/span\u003E No shifting dullness present.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EAuscultation:\u003C\/span\u003E Bowel sounds heard.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPER RECTAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E Tone normal. Finger stained with bloody yellowish stools with mucus.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECVS-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E S\u003C\/span\u003E1S2 heard, No murmurs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ERS-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E Bilateral air entry present, Normal vesicular breath sounds.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECNS-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E HMF Intact, No focal neurological deficit.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white; color: #800180;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EWORKING DIAGNOSIS:\u003C\/b\u003E \u003C\/span\u003EAcute diarrhoea under evaluation-?TB Abdomen ?IBD First episode\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurther we ordered certain blood investigations and imaging to rule out infectious causes of diarrhoea. Meanwhile we prescribed Rifaximin and metronidazole for 5 days and asked to review with the reports.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe came back with the following reports exactly a week later with no improvement in his symptoms.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; He was asked to continue the same medication for next 2 weeks.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe consumed outside food and came back with increased frequency of stools after a week and was prescribed azithromycin along with mescal and probiotic.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe came for review after a week.
